# Purpose

The purpose of this chapter is to identify which patient samples we're not including in survival and response analyses. 

# Set up

We'll start by reading in the clinical metadata table.  

```{r}
bulk_clin_metadata <- read_tsv(here("data", "bulk", "bulk-clin-metadata.tsv"))
```

```{r}
bulk_clin_metadata %>% 
  group_by(cohort) %>% 
  count()
```

There are 59 patients which were sequentially treated. 

```{r}
bulk_clin_metadata %>% 
  filter(cohort == "2016 Weber") %>% 
  nrow()
```

```{r}
bulk_clin_metadata %>% 
  filter(cohort == "2023 Campbell (067)")
```
